expected_detection_rule: invoice count per booking_id should be exactly one
rationale: Cloned an existing invoice and its lines under a new invoice_id for the same booking to simulate an accidental double-bill.

expected_detection_rule: issued invoice with total_amount > 0 and no successful payment should surface as outstanding
rationale: Every payment attempt against this invoice failed; no successful payment exists.

expected_detection_rule: payment.amount should not exceed its invoice.total_amount
rationale: Payment amount was increased above the invoice total, leaving an unallocated excess.

expected_detection_rule: base_fare line amount should equal fare_class base_fare_usd + per_km_usd * route distance
rationale: Base fare amount overwritten to 208497.08 instead of the fare-class-derived 69493.36.

expected_detection_rule: refund.amount should not exceed the amount collected on the linked payment
rationale: Refund amount was raised above the amount actually collected on the linked payment.

expected_detection_rule: tickets on a cancelled flight_instance should have an associated refund or voucher
rationale: Flight instance marked cancelled after ticketing; the associated booking/invoice/payment were deliberately left untouched, so no refund exists for the affected passengers.

expected_detection_rule: payment_datetime_utc should normally fall within a few days of invoice_date_utc
rationale: Payment timestamp shifted to 75 days after the invoice date to simulate a late-arriving payment.

expected_detection_rule: sum(invoice_lines.amount) for an invoice should reconcile to invoice.total_amount
rationale: Removed tax line INL-00035 without adjusting the invoice header, so the header no longer reconciles to its lines.

expected_detection_rule: a flown ticket_segment's ticket should have a base_fare invoice_line to recognise as revenue
rationale: Removed base_fare line INL-00034 for a ticket with a flown segment.

expected_detection_rule: payments.invoice_id should resolve to an existing invoices.invoice_id
rationale: Appended a payment referencing invoice_id 'INV-99999', which does not exist in invoices.csv.

expected_detection_rule: an ancillary sold against a flown ticket should ordinarily be fulfilled
rationale: Forced fulfilment_status to 'not_fulfilled' for an ancillary sold on an otherwise-flown ticket.

expected_detection_rule: a fulfilled ancillary_service should have a matching invoice_line of line_type='ancillary'
rationale: Removed the invoice_line for an ancillary_service already marked fulfilled.

expected_detection_rule: payment.currency should equal the currency of its invoice
rationale: Payment currency set to USD while its invoice remains EUR, with no recorded conversion.

expected_detection_rule: adjustments.invoice_id should resolve to an existing invoice and amount should be plausible
rationale: Appended an adjustment referencing a non-existent invoice_id with an implausibly large amount.
